preserve_constraints: Keep exactly one lion visible in the image.

Add negative constraints against extra lions, raccoons, or croissants and against hidden or merged raccoons.
regression_risks: Adding a stronger chase layout could accidentally move some raccoons to the right of the croissant, so the prompt must keep every raccoon left of the croissant.
Emphasizing seven raccoons may lead to extra raccoon-like duplicates, so the prompt must say exactly seven and no extras.

Make the lion clearly chasing the raccoons: place the lion directly behind the raccoons, facing and lunging toward them, while the raccoons are ahead of it fleeing away.
Show exactly seven raccoons: seven separate, fully visible, non-overlapping raccoons arranged in a countable line or staggered group, with no extra raccoons and no merged duplicates.
